paper.authors: Campello, Murillo; Cortes, Gustavo S.; d'Almeida, Fabrício; Kankanhalli, Gaurav
paper.title: Exporting Uncertainty: The Impact of Brexit on Corporate America
paper.journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis

choice_rationale: Table 8 is the only table in the paper or supplementary appendix reporting a DiD specification with CASH as the dependent variable. Column 1 is chosen as the primary/baseline because it uses the market-based β^UK_i exposure measure (top vs. bottom tercile), which the paper designates as its baseline treatment-assignment scheme throughout (Section IV.C.1, p. 3193); column 2 uses the alternative textual-search-based measure and is presented as a secondary specification.
specification_description: Difference-in-differences estimate of the effect of the 2016 Brexit referendum vote on cash holdings of U.K.-exposed U.S. firms (top tercile of β^UK_i) versus non-exposed firms (bottom tercile of β^UK_i), comparing 2016:Q3–Q4 to 2015:Q3–Q4.

sample_filters: Drop non-US firm–quarters (retain data reported in USD, with US headquarters, duplicates excluded)
Drop firm–quarters with negative fundamentals (ASSETS and SALES)
Drop if ASSETS or MARKET_CAPITALIZATION less than $10 million
Drop if missing key variables (INVESTMENT, ASSETS, CASH_FLOW, TOBIN_Q, SALES_GROWTH)
Drop if non-consecutive quarters, or less than 12 quarters of non-missing data
Drop if missing Hoberg and Phillips (2016) industry classification
Drop if missing CRSP and I/B/E/S controls
Treatment group: top tercile of β^UK_i
Control group: bottom tercile of β^UK_i
All variables winsorized at the 1% level
